claims.text: The latest stable Pulumi release is v3.263.0, released 2026-09-16 (the at-a-glance table at L134 lists v3.261.0 dated 2026-09-02, which conflicts with the later table and section).
The latest stable Terraform release is v1.16.3, released 2026-09-16 (the at-a-glance table at L135 lists v1.16.1 dated 2026-09-02).
The latest stable AWS CDK release is v2.270.0, released 2026-09-17 (the at-a-glance table at L136 lists v2.268.0 dated 2026-09-02).
The latest stable Azure Bicep release is v0.47.16, released 2026-09-08 (the at-a-glance table at L139 still lists v0.46.1 dated 2026-07-30).
The latest stable Kubernetes release is v1.37.0, released 2026-08-26.
The latest stable Crossplane release is v2.4.1, released 2026-09-15 (the at-a-glance table at L142 lists v2.4.0 dated 2026-08-20).
The latest stable OpenTofu release is v1.12.6, released 2026-08-19.
The tool version and release-date figures in the comparison table are dated snapshots checked against each project's GitHub releases on 2026-09-21.
GitHub star counts as of 2026-09-21: Pulumi ~25.7k, Terraform ~49.7k, AWS CDK ~12.9k, Azure Bicep ~3.6k, Kubernetes ~127.9k, Crossplane ~12.1k, OpenTofu ~30.2k.
Among dedicated IaC tools, Terraform is the most-starred on GitHub, followed by OpenTofu, Pulumi, AWS CDK, and Crossplane.
Kubernetes leads the broader infrastructure ecosystem by GitHub stars and is the de facto container orchestration standard.
Pulumi, OpenTofu, and Crossplane have grown fastest among teams prioritizing general-purpose languages, open governance, or Kubernetes-native infrastructure management, respectively.
Terraform's larger community reflects a decade of first-mover adoption.
The pricing table reflects published pricing as of September 2026.
env0 is now named env zero (formerly env0).
Spacelift's paid plans scale by private worker count rather than seats or resources, with quote-based pricing at the top end.
env zero prices its paid tiers per successful apply or environment.
Google Cloud Deployment Manager reached end of support on March 31, 2026.
Google Cloud Deployment Manager will be fully turned down on June 30, 2027.
Google Cloud Infrastructure Manager replaces Google Cloud Deployment Manager and automates deployment and management of Google Cloud resources using Terraform configurations.
Pulumi Cloud's Free edition is free forever for one user, with unlimited stacks and projects and 500 workflow minutes per month.
Pulumi Cloud's Essentials plan starts at $40/month, including 40 credits and up to 500 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud's Pro plan starts at $400/month, including 400 credits and up to 2,000 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud's Enterprise plan is custom, contract-priced.
HCP Terraform is free for up to 500 managed resources with one concurrent run, then moves to per-resource pricing of roughly $0.10 to $0.99 per resource per month depending on tier.
Terraform Enterprise (self-hosted) is available at custom pricing for larger organizations.
The managed-platform pricing figures reflect published pricing checked on 2026-09-21.
Terraform is licensed under BUSL-1.1, which is not OSI-approved, and HashiCorp is an IBM company.
